_what: The workspace's words for every tour (parts/guided-overlay, the host mounted in main.tsx), and the facts a tour step may wait on. end_label names the control on every step that ends the whole tour (Skip only moves past one step). closing_step is the one step shown when a tour is ended before its last step: it points at where every tour is kept, so the person knows where to take it again. more_waiting is the button a card carries when other tours wait behind it ({count} is how many): it opens Waiting tours, where each can be shown, hidden for a while, or dismissed. readbacks names, for each fact a step's owner-readback condition reads (readback_ref), the address that answers it; ai-connection.ts reads the same row.

payload.title: Take any tour again from Tours
